description: This file contains unit tests for CancellationToken functionality within an Orleans-based distributed system. It defines multiple test classes and methods to verify cancellation behavior across grains, including propagation, acknowledgment, and inter-silo communication.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_WaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Test class for cancellation token acknowledgment enabled scenario.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests_NoWaitForAcknowledgement
classes.description: Test class for cancellation token acknowledgment disabled scenario.

classes.name: CancellationTokenTests
classes.description: Base class containing various cancellation token propagation and handling tests.

methods.name: GrainTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation of a long-running grain task with different delays.

methods.name: MultipleGrainsTaskCancellation
methods.description: Tests cancellation across multiple grains simultaneously.

methods.name: GrainTaskMultipleCancellations
methods.description: Tests multiple cancellation requests on a single grain call.

methods.name: TokenPassingWithoutCancellation_NoExceptionShouldBeThrown
methods.description: Verifies that passing a non-cancelled token does not throw exceptions.

methods.name: PreCancelledTokenPassing
methods.description: Verifies behavior when passing an already cancelled token.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksExecutionContext
methods.description: Tests execution context of cancellation token callbacks.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksTaskSchedulerContext
methods.description: Tests task scheduler context during cancellation callbacks.

methods.name: CancellationTokenCallbacksThrow_ExceptionDoesNotPropagate
methods.description: Ensures exceptions in callbacks do not propagate.

methods.name: CancellationTestCore
methods.description: Core logic for in-silo and inter-silo cancellation tests.

methods.name: GetGrains
methods.description: Helper to obtain grains on different silos for testing.

methods.description: Waits for a specific call cancellation to be observed.

methods.name: WaitForCallCancellation
methods.description: Overload to wait for multiple call cancellations.
